context.transcript:
Today I'll be presenting the work of Moritz Hoffman.
Moritz spent the last two years designing and renovating the City Hall building, saving a truly historic building, one of the oldest in Madison.
A project of this scale requires a great deal of careful planning and attention to detail, and Moritz spent a great deal of time on preparation.
The whole process was documented with photographs.
Now let's look at some slides of the City Hall before and after renovations.
context.transcript_translation:
今天我将介绍 Moritz Hoffman 的工作。
Moritz 在过去两年里设计和翻修了市政厅大楼，拯救了一座真正历史悠久的建筑，这是麦迪逊最古老的建筑之一。
这样一个规模的项目需要大量的仔细规划和对细节的关注，Moritz 花费了大量时间进行准备。
整个过程都用照片记录了下来。
现在让我们看看市政厅翻修前后的几张幻灯片。
